Jason Scott Rosen is a worldbuilding creative production director, experience producer, emergent technologies administrator, and business strategist who is a passionate leader of compelling contributions of transmedia arts & narrative technologies

Based across Atlanta, New York, Seattle, and Los Angeles, he steers complex multi-phase productions through to launch — leading cross-functional teams for some of the world's most prominent brands, organizations, and institutions.

He consults at the executive level across immersive, interactive, digital, experiential, entertainment, attraction, product, and live production — pushing innovation at the convergence of media, arts, and communication technologies.
